entries.title: Portable surface contract
entries.summary: Portable Haxe-first surface is explicitly documented and scoped through the compatibility matrix and stdlib coverage plan.

entries.title: OCaml-native surface contract
entries.summary: The opt-in `ocaml.*` surface is explicitly documented and treated as non-portable target-specific API.

entries.title: Target-owned runtime module inventory
entries.summary: Runtime modules and portable/metal status are explicitly inventoried so target-owned runtime responsibilities are visible.

entries.title: Core target-owned stdlib overrides
entries.summary: Core override/runtime-backed modules needed by the declared scope are named and cross-linked to implementation surfaces.

entries.title: Build and dune integration
entries.summary: The declared product scope includes deterministic OCaml output and dune-based build integration, documented from the user-facing guides.

entries.title: Upstream-Haxe validation examples
entries.summary: Representative repo-owned examples now define the declared upstream-Haxe product matrix for compile/build/run validation.

entries.title: Multi-host promotion proofs
entries.summary: Promotion paths are a separate product/workflow concern and are owned by the promotion matrix contract, not by the standalone target-closure audit.

entries.title: Strict hxhx compiler-equivalence proof
entries.summary: Strict hxhx Full 1.0 equivalence is a separate compiler claim and must not be smuggled into the target-product closure audit.
